title: openvinotoolkit/openvino
lede: OpenVINO is an open-source C++ toolkit that converts trained models and runs optimized inference on CPUs, Intel GPUs and NPUs, from edge devices to the cloud.

points: It takes models from PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX, Keras, PaddlePaddle and JAX/Flax and deploys them without the original framework.
Targets include x86 and ARM CPUs, Intel integrated and discrete GPUs, and Intel NPUs.
APIs ship for C++, Python, C and Node.js, with a GenAI API for LLM and image-generation pipelines.
It plugs into Hugging Face through Optimum Intel, and into torch.compile, ExecuTorch, vLLM, ONNX Runtime, LangChain and LlamaIndex.
It collects usage telemetry by default, which one command switches off.
